title: The Evidence Anchoring Boundary: Where Visual Interventions Matter and When They Help in Multimodal LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.12981v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual interventions provide a training-free way to reduce hallucinations in multimodal large language models. However, an intervention may have little leverage at some layers and may damage a correct answer even when it changes the output. We investigate where visual interventions retain leverage and when they improve predictions. First, we apply the same visual-residual edit at successive decoder layers, matching its RMS strength across depth. Across six checkpoints from three model families, we observe a persistent drop in intervention effect and define its operational onset for this edit as the \textbf{Evidence Anchoring Boundary (EAB)}. With boundaries fixed on calibration queries, held-out effects on disjoint evaluation queries before EAB are $13.78\times$--$26.10\times$ larger than those after it. translated_title: 证据锚定边界：视觉干预在多模态大语言模型中的关键层级与有效时机
translated_abstract: 视觉干预提供了一种无需训练的方法来减少多模态大语言模型中的幻觉。然而，干预在某些层可能几乎没有作用力，即使它改变了输出，也可能损害原本正确的答案。我们研究了视觉干预在哪些层级保持作用力，以及何时能够改进预测。首先，我们在连续的解码器层上应用相同的视觉残差编辑，并在不同深度上匹配其RMS强度。在来自三个模型系列的六个检查点上，我们观察到干预效果持续下降，并将该编辑效果的操作性起点定义为证据锚定边界（Evidence Anchoring Boundary, EAB）。在基于校准查询固定边界后，EAB之前的不相交评估查询上的保留效果是EAB之后的13.78倍至26.10倍。与中间读出的对比表明，编辑可能在答案偏好稳定之前就失去作用力。其次，我们比较了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现了多模态大语言模型中的“证据锚定边界”（EAB），证明视觉干预在该边界之前层级的干预效果是边界之后的13.78至26.10倍，为确定视觉干预的有效层级和时机提供了新依据。
